activate_my_card: Activating a newly received physical payment card.
age_limit: Minimum or maximum age requirements for an account or card.
apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using the card or account with Apple Pay, Google Pay, or another mobile wallet.
atm_support: Whether or how the card can be used at an ATM.
automatic_top_up: Automatic card or balance top-ups and how they work.
balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Account balance not updating after an incoming bank transfer.
balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Account balance not updating after a cheque or cash deposit.
beneficiary_not_allowed: An attempted transfer beneficiary or recipient is not allowed.
cancel_transfer: Cancelling a bank transfer that has been initiated.
card_about_to_expire: A physical payment card approaching its expiration date.
card_acceptance: Where or whether a payment card is accepted.
card_arrival: A new or replacement physical card has not arrived or its arrival status.
card_delivery_estimate: Estimated delivery time for a physical payment card.
card_linking: Linking an existing physical card to the app or account.
card_not_working: A physical card generally does not work, without a more specific payment or cash-withdrawal issue.
card_payment_fee_charged: A fee charged for making a card payment.
card_payment_not_recognised: An unrecognized or suspected fraudulent card payment.
card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: An incorrect exchange rate applied to a card payment.
card_swallowed: A card retained by an ATM or cash machine.
cash_withdrawal_charge: A fee charged for withdrawing cash at an ATM.
cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: An unrecognized or suspected fraudulent cash withdrawal.
change_pin: Changing the PIN for a physical payment card.
compromised_card: A card may be compromised or its security details exposed.
contactless_not_working: Contactless card payments do not work.
country_support: Whether the service supports a country or is available there.
declined_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal at an ATM was declined.
disposable_card_limits: Limits or restrictions on disposable virtual cards.
edit_personal_details: Changing personal account details such as name, address, or phone number.
exchange_rate: How exchange rates are determined or what rate applies.
exchange_via_app: Exchanging currencies using the mobile app.
extra_charge_on_statement: An extra or small unexpected charge shown on a card statement.
failed_transfer: A bank transfer failed after being initiated, rather than being declined before processing.
get_disposable_virtual_card: Obtaining a disposable virtual payment card.
get_physical_card: Obtaining or ordering a physical payment card.
getting_spare_card: Getting an additional or spare physical card.
getting_virtual_card: Obtaining or accessing a standard virtual payment card.
lost_or_stolen_card: A physical payment card is lost or stolen.
lost_or_stolen_phone: The phone used to access the account is lost or stolen.
order_physical_card: Placing an order for a physical payment card.
pending_top_up: A card or account top-up is pending.
pin_blocked: A card PIN is blocked or locked.
receiving_money: Receiving money into the account from another person or transfer.
Refund_not_showing_up: A refund is expected but has not appeared.
request_refund: Requesting a refund for a card payment or purchase.
reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reversed or reverted after appearing to complete.
supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards or currencies can be used for card top-ups.
top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up by bank transfer.
top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up by payment card.
top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up by cash or cheque.
top_up_failed: A card or account top-up failed.
top_up_limits: Limits on card or account top-ups.
top_up_reverted: A previously completed top-up was reversed or reverted.
topping_up_by_card: How to top up an account using a payment card.
transaction_charged_twice: A card transaction was charged more than once.
transfer_fee_charged: A fee charged for a bank transfer.
transfer_into_account: Making a bank transfer into the account.
transfer_not_received_by_recipient: A completed transfer has not been received by its intended recipient.
transfer_timing: How long a bank transfer takes or its expected timing.
verify_source_of_funds: Verifying the source of account funds.
virtual_card_not_working: A virtual payment card does not work.
visa_or_mastercard: Whether the physical card is Visa or Mastercard.
wrong_amount_of_cash_received: An ATM dispensed the wrong amount of cash.
wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: An incorrect exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal.
